platform: 8 NVIDIA B200 GPUs, 224 logical CPUs, 2 TiB RAM, PostgreSQL 17.6, cuVS 26.10, CUDA 13
dataset: 10M rows x 128 FP32 dimensions, NVFP4 scan, FP16 CAGRA, one shard, tmpfs

calibration.qualification: Mean recall across all query vectors in each request; not a per-query guarantee

notes: Training vectors 1..32; interpolation and route-validation vectors 65..96. CAGRA search budget was tuned using validation vectors, so these are not an untouched final quality holdout.
FP64 exact references use original exported FP32 vectors and are checked against local SQL for each first vector.
Main stress requests return 500 keys per vector, with all query errors counted. All measured cost routes in this stress test were NVFP4 scan + GPU reranking.
Single 15-second points have no confidence intervals. Saturated QPS is essentially unchanged; p99 regressed at 10% filtering. Keep this latency profile opt-in.
Absolute node paths are retained for reproducibility; no authentication secrets are included. Recalibrate for another generation, graph, SDK or hardware.
Final independent vectors 129..160 were checked after CAGRA budget tuning; all 90 calibrated requests passed 95% mean recall and cardinality.
Integration includes the newer origin/master upstream pgvector merge; benchmark baseline was f9a71f6. Upstream changes do not touch the frozen or GPU routes.
